Image Description: The image shows a row of four yellow bicycles parked side by side on a paved sidewalk in an urban setting. Each bicycle is equipped with a large, bright red insulated delivery box mounted on the rear rack. The boxes are rectangular and feature white lids, with visible branding or logos that include black text and symbols, possibly indicating a food delivery service. The bikes are secured to a metal bike rack embedded in the pavement.

In the background, there is a modern building with a distinctive architectural design
